sections.title: Items
sections.note: Six palace items, the Hammer and Magic Key, and the six things townsfolk need, in a rough order of play.

items.name: Candle
items.howTo: In Parapa Palace. Lights dark caves.

items.name: Trophy
items.howTo: In a cave in the far north of the desert north of North Castle, guarded by a Goriya. Return it to the woman in Ruto.

items.name: Bagu's note
items.area: Bagu's house, the woods north of Saria
items.howTo: A sleeping Bot in Saria points to Bagu. Show his note to the guard at Saria's river to cross the bridge toward Death Mountain.

items.name: Mirror
items.howTo: Under the table in the first house of the town's second part. Return it to the woman in the second house of the first part.

items.name: Hammer
items.howTo: At the end of the Death Mountain cave maze, entered from the cave south of Saria. Breaks boulders and clears forest.
items.notes: Guarded by Dairas. Zelda Wiki only says Death Mountain.

items.name: Water of Life
items.area: Cave in the Moruge Swamp, north of Saria
items.howTo: Break the boulder in front of the cave with the Hammer; three Dairas guard it. Take it to the old woman in Mido for her sick child.
items.notes: Medicine on StrategyWiki. Zelda Wiki puts the cave just west of Midoro Palace; StrategyWiki and both Zelda Dungeon guides put it in the Moruge Swamp.

items.name: Handy Glove
items.howTo: In Midoro Palace. Breaks blocks with the sword, and is needed to reach the boss.

items.name: Raft
items.howTo: In an outdoor room of the Island Palace. From the dock south of Mido it sails to Eastern Hyrule.

items.name: Water from the fountain
items.howTo: Fill up at the fountain in the town's second part and bring it to the thirsty woman next door.

items.name: Child
items.howTo: In a hidden pit in the southeast corner of Maze Island, guarded by an orange Geru. Bring the child home to Darunia.
items.notes: The Lost Child on StrategyWiki; the Kidnapped Child on Zelda Dungeon.

items.name: Boots
items.howTo: In the Maze Island Palace. Link can walk on hidden paths over water.

items.name: Flute
items.howTo: In the Palace on the Sea. Scares off the River Devil and raises the Three-Eye Rock Palace.
items.notes: Zelda Wiki's palace page calls it the Whistle.

items.name: Magic Key
items.howTo: Hammer the forest tile in the eastern woods (through the Kasuto cave) to reveal New Kasuto. There, cast Spell at the dead end of the town's third part: a building rises with the key inside. It opens every locked door.
items.notes: The Magical Key on Zelda Wiki.

items.name: Cross
items.howTo: Dropped after the first Rebonack in the Three-Eye Rock Palace. Shows invisible enemies.
